Key finding: two tours carry the whole map — **Jimmy Carr** ("Laughs Funny", 10 of 17 cities, Jun→Dec) and **Ali Wong** ("Ali Wong Live", 8 cities in a 17 Jun–11 Jul sprint). Outside those plus London and Zürich, English-language comedy means recurring expat-scene clubs, and the marquee names you'd expect (Mulaney, Burr, McIntyre, Ranganathan, Mischief) all skip the continent this year.
